title: Unit economics: reconciliation job vs billing hooks + variance alerting
author: Cole Summers
release_notes: Adds a daily reconciliation job that compares unit-econ aggregates to billing hooks by (day, region, customer_tier) and alerts on variance beyond agreed thresholds; includes backfill tooling + runbook.
commits: analytics: add unit_econ_reconciliation_daily job scaffold + config
warehouse: add billing_hooks_daily view + normalization for regions/tier mapping
alerts: add reconciliation_variance monitor and routing to #eng-sre / #eng-platform
tools: add backfill CLI with dry-run + partition range support
docs: add runbook link + troubleshooting notes (late events / region mapping)
body: Title: Unit economics: reconciliation job vs billing hooks + variance alerting Context: As part of the internal unit economics dashboard rollout, Finance needs daily tie-outs between dashboard totals and invoice/metering totals. We already compute blended $/1M output tokens, but we did not have a reliable automated reconciliation loop (and alerts) to catch mapping issues, late-arriving metering events, or schema drift in billing hooks. This PR implements ENG-2914: a daily reconciliation job comparing unit-econ aggregates to billing hooks and alerting on variance thresholds, with a backfill tool and runbook pointers. What this changes: 1) New job `unit_econ_reconciliation_daily` (runs hourly, reconciles last 3 days; publishes a canonical daily table) 2) New curated view `billing_hooks_daily_normalized` to ensure we’re comparing apples-to-apples (region canonicalization + tier mapping + credit/discount handling aligned to ADR) 3) New table `unit_econ.reconciliation_daily` keyed by (ds, region, customer_tier) with fields for totals, variance, and explainable flags 4) New alert `Unit Econ Reconciliation Variance` firing when absolute variance exceeds threshold OR relative variance exceeds threshold for sufficiently large spend, routed to #eng-sre and #eng-platform with a link to the runbook 5) Backfill tooling to reprocess historical partitions safely (supports dry-run and automatic guardrails against overwriting “locked” finance-reviewed days) Metric definition alignment: This reconciliation compares dashboard-side totals computed from telemetry aggregation vs billing hooks totals from `billing_usage_daily` (aka “hooks”). In both cases we use the same inclusions/exclusions as the current finance alignment: include compute + allocated overhead in unit-econ cost; exclude support fees and one-off credits; treat promotional credits as revenue offsets (i.e., excluded from cost basis for the “blended cost” definition) — see ADR-0142. If Finance later wants a “net” view including credits/discounts, we can add a separate reconciliation mode; for now this is the canonical “blended cost” tie-out path. Variance thresholds (current): - Hard fail: abs(variance_usd) > 2,000 AND rel_variance > 1.5% for a (ds, region, tier) slice - Soft warn: rel_variance > 1.0% for any slice with billing_total_usd > 50,000/day - Separate alert: missing slices / cardinality regression (expected region/tier combos absent) Note: thresholds are configurable in `alerts/unit_econ_reconciliation.yaml` and we can tune once we have a few weeks of baseline. Late data handling: We treat the last 48h as “hot” and expect higher churn due to late metering events; the job recomputes T-0/T-1/T-2 each run and marks partitions as `finalized=false`. Once a partition is older than 72h and passes variance checks for 2 consecutive runs, we mark `finalized=true` and stop rewriting unless a manual backfill is invoked. This is intended to reduce dashboard flip-flopping while still converging on correct totals. Backfill tooling: Added `tools/unit_econ/backfill_reconciliation.py` supporting: `--start-date`, `--end-date`, `--regions`, `--tiers`, `--dry-run`, and `--force` (required to overwrite finalized partitions). The tool prints expected row counts and a preflight diff summary before executing. Runbook: - Confluence: Eng Infra Runbooks -> Unit Econ -> “Reconciliation variance spike” (linked in job logs and alert description) - Quick pointers are also in `docs/runbooks/unit_econ_reconciliation.md` for oncall. Files/areas touched (high level): - `analytics/jobs/unit_econ_reconciliation_daily.py` (new) - `analytics/sql/unit_econ/reconciliation_daily.sql` (new) - `warehouse/dbt/models/billing/billing_hooks_daily_normalized.sql` (new) - `warehouse/dbt/models/unit_econ/unit_econ_cost_daily.sql` (uses existing dataset, adds stable naming for join keys) - `observability/alerts/unit_econ_reconciliation.yaml` (new) - `tools/unit_econ/backfill_reconciliation.py` (new) - `docs/runbooks/unit_econ_reconciliation.md` (new) Illustrative snippet (variance logic): `WITH joined AS ( SELECT u.ds, u.region, u.customer_tier, u.total_cost_usd AS unit_econ_cost_usd, b.total_cost_usd AS billing_cost_usd FROM unit_econ_cost_daily u FULL OUTER JOIN billing_hooks_daily_normalized b USING (ds, region, customer_tier) ) SELECT ds, region, customer_tier, unit_econ_cost_usd, billing_cost_usd, (unit_econ_cost_usd - billing_cost_usd) AS variance_usd, SAFE_DIVIDE((unit_econ_cost_usd - billing_cost_usd), NULLIF(billing_cost_usd, 0)) AS rel_variance, CASE WHEN billing_cost_usd IS NULL THEN 'missing_in_billing' WHEN unit_econ_cost_usd IS NULL THEN 'missing_in_unit_econ' WHEN ABS(unit_econ_cost_usd - billing_cost_usd) > {{ var('abs_threshold_usd') }} AND ABS(SAFE_DIVIDE(unit_econ_cost_usd - billing_cost_usd, NULLIF(billing_cost_usd, 0))) > {{ var('rel_threshold') }} THEN 'threshold_breached' ELSE 'ok' END AS status FROM joined;` Testing: - Unit tests cover join key normalization (region canonicalization) and finalized partition rules - Warehouse/dbt tests validate uniqueness by (ds, region, tier) and non-negative totals - Integration test seeds a known mismatch and asserts alert payload includes runbook link and the top offending slices Rollout plan: - Merge behind `UNIT_ECON_RECONCILIATION_ENABLED` (default on in staging, off in prod) - Enable in prod after 2 days of monitoring in staging and once Finance confirms the tie-out output shape works for their weekly review Notes / known limitations: - We currently reconcile at (day, region, customer_tier). Model-level reconciliation is intentionally deferred due to known mapping gaps in billing hooks; we can extend once hooks support consistent model identifiers for Dedicated/Private. - Some “region” mismatches are still possible for EU (eu-west vs eu-west-1); this PR centralizes canonicalization but relies on the existing region mapping table being correct. SUP-8841 is referenced because that incident was rooted in region mapping drift; this job should catch it earlier next time. Review conversation (highlights): Logan Wright (2025-02-13): Can you confirm we’re not rewriting partitions older than 72h automatically? We had issues with dashboard numbers changing mid-week. Cole Summers (2025-02-13): Yep — after 72h + 2 consecutive OK runs we mark `finalized=true`. Only manual backfill with `--force` can overwrite, and it emits a preflight diff. Nadia Rahman (2025-02-14): Join key canonicalization: please ensure `customer_tier` mapping is versioned historically (don’t apply today’s tier to last month). Cole Summers (2025-02-14): Good catch. Updated to join through the tier mapping SCD table on ds, not current tier. Added dbt test to catch null tier joins. Aisha Bello (2025-02-15): Alert routing should page only when it’s actionable; can we add a spend floor to avoid noise for small slices? Cole Summers (2025-02-15): Added `billing_total_usd > 50k` spend floor to the “warn” condition and kept the “hard fail” gated by both abs + rel thresholds. Alert now includes the top 5 slices by absolute variance and the job run id. Rishi Malhotra (2025-02-16): Confirming: this matches the CFO guidance that ‘blended cost’ excludes promotional credits and focuses on cost basis for margin reporting. Please add the ADR link directly in the alert text. Cole Summers (2025-02-16): Done — ADR link added to the alert description and runbook. Approvals: Logan Wright (approved 2025-02-17) Nadia Rahman (approved 2025-02-17) Aisha Bello (approved 2025-02-18) Rishi Malhotra (approved 2025-02-18) Merge: Squash merge to main after CI green; enabled in staging post-merge. Follow-ups: - ENG-2917 will add broader data quality monitors; this PR focuses on reconciliation specifically - Potential V2: add model-family reconciliation once billing hooks expose stable model identifiers across tiers
